mapper.select: select c.id, c.job_id, c.user_id, c.reason, c.create_time, u.user_name, u.user_picture, j.title as job_title, e.name as company_name from job_complaint c left join sys_user u on c.user_id = u.user_id left join job j on c.job_id = j.id left join enterprise e on j.enterprise_id = e.id where c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into job_complaint (job_id, user_id, reason, create_time) values (#{jobId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{createTime})
